description: Land Acquisition - Andagala, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Correction Notice, Ex. Gaz. No. 2362/45 on 13.12.2023
categorisation: This gazette notice is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It directs the acquisition officer to take possession of a specific land parcel described in detail (including lot numbers, boundaries, extent, and location). While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. This fits the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
